# v0.3.21 — New topics recognised from the first reply; deleted and archived chats leave routing

## What's changed

- **Topic cards.** After a topic's first reply, and once more after its fourth, TheOne writes a short card in the background: what the topic is, other names you use for it, the people, places and files involved, and what is still open. Routing now recognises a topic in your own words from the start, instead of knowing little more than its title. This costs two small model calls per new topic and is never shown.
- **Recently active vs. set aside.** Routing sees when each topic was last active. A topic left alone longer than you usually come back to one is set aside: still reachable, just considered last. The line is learned from your own use (7 days until there is enough history), and a topic that has come back after long breaks before keeps a longer line of its own.
- **Deleted and archived chats leave routing** ([#3](https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone/issues/3), fixed in [#5](https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone/pull/5) by @jiuxinya, reported by @ao882866-ux). When every conversation behind a topic is gone from disk or archived in DSH, the topic is hidden from routing and from other topics' briefings. The directory still shows it, with the reason, so you can delete it. Restore or unarchive the conversation and it comes back.
- **README:** a step-by-step install for people new to DSH (`dsh-theone` from npm), and the results of our routing benchmark, InterleaveBench.
- Settings now list two experimental switches for sharing confirmed facts between topics. Both are off by default and still being evaluated; we don't recommend turning them on yet.

Validation: automated tests (191) and type checks passed. Topic cards are new and have not yet been through long real-world use; they can be turned off with the plugin config option `topicCards: false`.

## 中文

- **话题卡片**：话题第一次回复后（以及第四次回复后再一次），TheOne 会在后台写一张简短的卡片：这件事是什么、你会用哪些别的说法叫它、涉及的人名地名和文件、还有什么没定。从此路由一开始就能认出你换了说法的话题，而不是只知道一个标题。每个新话题多两次很小的模型调用，界面上什么都不显示。
- **最近活跃与搁置**：路由能看到每个话题多久前活跃过。超过你平时回头的间隔还没动的话题会被视为搁置：仍然可以被分到，只是排在最后。这个间隔从你自己的使用中学出来（数据不够时按 7 天）；以前隔很久又被捡起来的话题，会有更长的间隔。
- **已删除、已归档的会话不再参与路由**（[#3](https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone/issues/3)，由 @jiuxinya 在 [#5](https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone/pull/5) 修复，@ao882866-ux 报告）：一个话题背后的会话全部从磁盘消失或在 DSH 里归档后，它不再参与路由，也不再出现在其他话题的简报里。目录里仍然显示它并注明原因，可以手动删除；会话恢复或取消归档后，它会自动回来。
- **README**：新增给 DSH 新手的分步安装说明（从 npm 安装 `dsh-theone`），以及我们的路由评测 InterleaveBench 的结果。
- 设置里出现了两个「共享已确认的要点」的实验开关，默认关闭，仍在评测中，暂不建议开启。

已通过自动化测试（191 项）和类型检查。话题卡片是新功能，还没经过长时间的真实使用；如有需要，可以用插件配置 `topicCards: false` 关闭。
